content.title: How to Watch Pirates vs. Mets Opening Series: SNP360, TV Channel, Live Stream, Full Schedule | Sportsnet Pittsburgh
content.text: If you purchase a product or register for an account through one of the links on our site, we may receive compensation. Learn more > The Pirates are opening the 2026 season with a road series against the Mets, and the first game comes with an important heads-up for anyone planning to watch through SportsNet Pittsburgh or SNP360.Opening Day is not airing on SportsNet Pittsburgh or SNP360. Instead, the season opener is a national exclusive on NBC and Peacock, with first pitch set for 1:15 p.m. ET on Thursday, March 26. The next two games in the series shift back to the usual local setup, with both the Saturday and Sunday matchups scheduled to air on SportsNet Pittsburgh. That means if you’re trying to watch the full opening series, you’ll likely need a mix of options. For Game 1, you’ll need NBC or Peacock. For Games 2 and 3, SNP is the main local home for the broadcast.For fans wondering how SNP360 fits in, the service is designed for viewers in SportsNet Pittsburgh’s home territory, which includes Pennsylvania, West Virginia, eastern Ohio, and parts of New York and Maryland. If you already get SportsNet Pittsburgh through a participating TV provider, you may already have SNP360 access at no extra cost by linking your provider login. If you don’t have SNP through cable or satellite, you can sign up directly through SNP360.SNP360 offers two main subscription paths for local fans who want to stream Pirates games carried by SportsNet Pittsburgh:Season Pass: $99.99 for six monthsMonthly Plan: $21.99 per monthThe app is available across several devices, including iPhone, Android, Roku, Apple TV, Fire TV and Google TV. One important note: an active SNP360 subscription is required for live SNP360 events, but that still won’t help for the opener because that game is on NBC/Peacock, not SNP.So the easy breakdown is this: if you want to watch the entire opening Mets series, make sure you have access to NBC or Peacock for Thursday, then SNP or SNP360 for the weekend games. That’s the cleanest way to avoid getting caught by the Opening Day switch.Pirates vs. Mets opening series scheduleSchedule and network info below are based on the Pirates’ official 2026 broadcast schedule.If you’re local and mainly care about the full Pirates season, SNP360 is still the most direct streaming option for most non-national games. But for this specific opening series, it’s all about remembering the one exception: Game 1 is national, Games 2 and 3 are local.
